patches.evidence: Official VW Nutzfahrzeuge technical data page 'Der neue Caddy': maximum height 1.826 mm for the standard Caddy. The earlier official page for the 2020 model (now filed under Vorgängermodelle) gave 1.833 mm, and MeinAuto.de also lists 1.826 mm.

Official VW Nutzfahrzeuge Austria technical data for the ID. Buzz GTX langer Radstand: Länge 4.962 mm, Breite ohne Außenspiegel 1.985 mm, Höhe ohne Dachreling 1.905 mm, Radstand 3.239 mm. This figure is for the GTX LWB variant on the Austrian site. Logistra gives a maximum height of about 1.927 to 1.936 mm.

MeinAuto.de, angurten.de (Q3 Sportback 2025 (FJ)) and carwow all list the new Q3 Sportback height as 1.559 mm. The official Audi dimension PDF (Q3-Sportback-Dimensions_0625) could not be read clearly in the search results.
angurten.de gives a wheelbase of 2.681 mm for the Audi Q3 Sportback 2025 (FJ), and MeinAuto.de lists the same value. The official Audi dimension PDF could not be read clearly.

ADAC (manufacturer data): Audi Q5 2.0 TDI MHEV plus quattro S tronic (ab 07/25) 4.717 x 1.900 x 1.647 mm (L x B x H). carwow, carsized and automobiledimension also give 1.647 mm. Motor1 gives 1.651 mm.
ADAC Autokatalog, Hyundai i20 1.2 Select (10/23 - 05/24), 3. Generation Facelift: Länge 4065 mm, Höhe 1450 mm, Radstand 2580 mm. Automoli confirms the same figures.
Hyundai press kit technical data (i20, 2020): Höhe 1.450 mm (1.455 mm with N Line), Länge 4.040 mm (4.075 mm N Line).
